basic_details.job_title: CSB Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Junior Research Fellow, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central Silk Board (CSB) is recruiting candidates for 2 Junior Research Fellow and Project Assistant vacancies on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 6 November 2026 reporting at 10:00 AM at the Central Office, Central Silk Board, BTM Layout, Madiwala, Bengaluru. Applicants must meet the post-wise qualifications, with Junior Research Fellow requiring MBA-Agribusiness Management/M.Sc.-Agricultural Marketing & Co-operation/Agricultural Economics/Agricultural Extension and Project Assistant requiring a Full-time degree in B.Sc.-Agriculture / Agri Business / S

age_limit.details: The upper age limit as on the date of notification is 35 years of age for Junior Research Fellow and 30 years of age for Project Assistant.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MBA-Agribusiness Management / M.Sc.-Agricultural Marketing & Co-operation / Agricultural Economics / Agricultural Extension from UGC recognised University
Full-time degree in B.Sc.-Agriculture / Agri Business / Sericulture

qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): MBA-Agribusiness Management / M.Sc.-Agricultural Marketing & Co-operation / Agricultural Economics / Agricultural Extension from UGC recognised University | Project Assistant (PA): Full-time degree in B.Sc.-Agriculture / Agri Business / Sericulture

important_instructions: Applications will NOT be accepted by post, e-mail, or courier. The engagement of Junior Research Fellow and Project Assistant positions is purely on a temporary/contractual basis and is co-terminus with the project only. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Original supportive documents must be presented for verification. The decision of the Director (Tech.) or Competent Authority, Central Office, CSB, Bengaluru-560068 shall be final in all respects.

content_sections.heading: CSB Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be engaged for the project titled "Value Chain Analysis and Efficiency Mapping of Mulberry Silk in India" (MTL 13004 MIC) at the RCS Section of Central Office, Central Silk Board, Bengaluru. content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit as on the date of notification is 35 years of age for Junior Research Fellow and 30 years of age for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: A passport size photograph Original and self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets (SSLC, PUC/HSC, B.Sc./M.Sc.) Birth Certificate NOC from present employer if employed Research experience documents, if applicable Caste certificate, if applicable Duly-filled-in application form (available on CSB website) and complete bio-data

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must attend the Walk-In-Interview on 06.11.2026 at 10:00 AM at the Central Office, Central Silk Board, BTM Layout, Madiwala, Bengaluru- 560068. Selection is based on qualification, experience, and performance in the interview as per project requirements. Provisional degree certificate holders are eligible if they produce photocopies of all mark sheets at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will NOT be accepted by post, e-mail, or courier. The engagement of Junior Research Fellow and Project Assistant positions is purely on a temporary/contractual basis and is co-terminus with the project only. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Original supportive documents must be presented for verification. The decision of the Director (Tech.) or Competent Authority, Central Office, CSB, Bengaluru-560068 shall be final in all respects.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CSB walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 6 November 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Central Office, Central Silk Board, BTM Layout, Madiwala, Bengaluru- 560068.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 for Junior Research Fellow and 1 for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBA-Agribusiness Management, M.Sc.-Agricultural Marketing & Co-operation, Agricultural Economics, or Agricultural Extension from a UGC recognised University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates need a full-time degree in B.Sc.-Agriculture, Agri Business, or Sericulture.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit as on the date of notification is 35 years for Junior Research Fellow and 30 years for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Junior Research Fellow receives Rs. 21,000 per month without GATE/NET or Rs. 31,000 per month with GATE/NET, plus admissible HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a temporary and contractual basis, co-terminus with the project up to October 2027 or completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a passport size photograph, duly-filled application, complete bio-data, and original and self-attested copies of educational certificates, birth certificate, caste certificate, and research experience or NOC if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply by post or email?
faq.answer: No, applications will not be accepted by post, email, or courier; candidates must attend the walk-in interview directly.
